syncCalendarDialog.title: Sync your Calendar with bsport
syncCalendarDialog.description: Get updates about your classes in every establishment by syncing your personal calendar with the Back Office. Copy and paste the URL below into either Google or Apple Calendar to get started.

google.title: Google:
google.instructions: Settings → Add calendar → From URL → Paste URL

apple.title: Apple:
apple.instructions: File → New Calendar Subscription → Paste URL
